title: ConfigApiContractSchema
description:
Schema-only envelope used to generate the frontend Config API contract.

It is never serialized by an HTTP handler. Keeping every request and
response DTO reachable from one Rust root makes generated TypeScript drift
mechanically detectable without duplicating wire shapes in the SPA.

BuyModelRoute.description:
Exact Buy-side route represented by one report and one durable model run.

`Pooled` may contain only non-vertical market categories. `Crypto` and
`Weather` are isolated category routes because their `ResearchProfile`,
domain-source, factor-plane, and serving-contract preimages are distinct.

BuyRouteBinding.description: Champion plus the optional challenger bound to one exact Buy route.

champion.description: Active champion used for production inference on this Route.

shadow.description: Optional governed challenger evaluated in shadow without serving trades.

oneOf.description:
Non-parametric monotone regression (pool-adjacent-violators).
Preferred with `>= min_samples_isotonic` samples.

Two-parameter sigmoid (Platt scaling); data-efficient for small
samples or near-sigmoid miscalibration.

CapitalTimeBucketLimit.description: Maximum capital lock permitted through one elapsed-time boundary.

end_secs.description: Exclusive upper duration of the bucket from decision time.

max_capital_usd.description: Maximum capital locked inside this bucket.

DataQualityConfig.description: Data quality thresholds for PIT features and facts.

feature_staleness_policy.description: Named policy for stale feature handling.

max_book_age_ms.description: Maximum age for a book snapshot before it is stale.

max_domain_observation_age_secs.description:
Maximum acceptable age (seconds) of the freshest domain observation for
a linked instrument at decision time
(`StalenessRule::MaxDomainObservationAge`).

max_execution_age_secs.description:
Maximum acceptable age (seconds) of the freshest finalized execution at
decision time (`StalenessRule::MaxExecutionAge`).

max_feature_bucket_age_secs.description:
Maximum acceptable age (seconds) of the freshest materialized feature
bucket at decision time. Governs offline/online feature staleness
(`StalenessRule::MaxFeatureBucketAge`) — independent of live ingest lag.

max_ingest_lag_ms.description:
Maximum acceptable ingest **pipeline** lag (enqueue→ClickHouse flush-ack),
in milliseconds. Live-plane backpressure health only — NOT venue book age.
Governs `DataQualitySnapshot.ingest_lag_exceeded`, execution admission, and
market-candidate selection.

max_stale_book_ratio_bps.description:
Maximum tolerated stale-book ratio across the live book plane (basis points).

Consumed by execution admission `DataQualityCheck` (#6): deny when
`stale_tokens / total_tokens * 10_000` exceeds this cap. Distilled into
frozen admission input at build time so checks never read config directly.

reject_crossed_books.description: Reject crossed books before feature generation.

reject_empty_books.description: Reject empty books before feature generation.

DecimalValue.description: Validated decimal value serialized as a JSON string without losing precision.

DeployApplyEffect.description: Apply semantics for static process configuration.

DeployConfigFieldDescriptor.description: Complete metadata for one static leaf or one wildcard dynamic-binding leaf.

DeployConfigFieldProjection.description: One descriptor and its exhaustive safe runtime value projection.

DeployFieldBounds.description: Exact numeric constraints represented without a floating-point conversion.

DeployFieldUnit.description: Unit rendered in generated comments and safe deployment projections.

DeployProjectedValue.description: Safe value projection selected by descriptor sensitivity.

DeployProtectedStatus.description: Whether a protected deploy value is configured without exposing its literal.

DeploySensitivity.description: Confidentiality policy for one deploy leaf.

DeployValidationRuleDescriptor.description: One stable validation rule exposed alongside every affected deploy leaf.

DeployValueKind.description: TOML value category exposed to documentation and inventory tooling.

EmergencyExitKind.description:
Emergency-exit action used when operational kill-switch handling escalates
to emergency state.

oneOf.description: Submit reduce-only liquidation exits within the configured slippage cap.
Route exits to manual operator handling only.

EmergencyExitPolicy.description: Default emergency-exit policy consumed by the operational kill-switch plane.

max_slippage_bps.description: Maximum slippage for automated emergency liquidation, in basis points.

EntryConditionWorkerConfig.description: Durable condition evaluator cadence, lease, and bounded-pass policy.

backstop_interval_ms.description:
Millisecond cadence of the safety backstop scan. Source notifications,
book wakes, and clock deadlines remain the primary wake paths.

expiry_batch_limit.description: Maximum number of expired instances transitioned in one expiry sweep.

lease_duration_secs.description: Duration in seconds of an exclusive instance-processing lease.

lease_renew_interval_secs.description:
Renewal cadence in seconds for a held lease; must remain shorter than
the lease duration so takeover is explicit and auditable.

next_evaluation_delay_ms.description:
Milliseconds before a still-active instance becomes eligible for its
next scheduled evaluation after one worker pass.

pass_limit.description: Maximum number of due condition instances evaluated in one worker pass.

max_slippage_bps.description: Maximum allowed entry-order slippage in basis points.

min_entry_book_depth_usd.description:
Minimum visible book depth (USD) required at entry. Frozen onto every
recommendation's `EntryPlan.min_depth_usd` at report build and enforced
by execution admission (`LiquidityDepthCheck`): an intent is deferred
when the fillable ask notional up to the limit price is below this
floor. The value must be strictly positive; there is no disabled or
unlimited sentinel.

ExecutionAuthorizationPolicy.description: Explicit authorization policy for recommendation entry intents.

operator_approval_ttl_secs.description:
Seconds an operator authorization remains valid before admission must
obtain fresh account, market, policy, and economic-health evidence.

ExecutionBreakerConfig.description:
Venue-dimension execution-breaker thresholds.

Drives the stateful execution breaker that watches venue submit/cancel
outcomes and publishes a `VenueHealth` seam for admission `#18` while
auto-tripping the operational kill-switch on sustained failure. Transient
degradation defers (admission retries); sustained failure halts and latches
the kill-switch (`execution_halted`, operator ack required to clear).

cooldown_secs.description: Seconds of failure-free operation before `Degraded` self-recovers to `Healthy`.

daily_realized_loss_cap_usd.description:
Daily realized-loss cap in USD (UTC day). Cumulative same-day realized
loss `≥ 80%` of the cap degrades venue health (admission `#18` defers);
`≥` the cap trips the kill-switch (`execution_halted`, latched). The
cap must be strictly positive; there is no disabled sentinel.

venue_consecutive_failures_to_degrade.description: Consecutive venue failures that move the breaker to `Degraded` (admission defers).

venue_consecutive_failures_to_halt.description: Consecutive venue failures that move the breaker to `Halted` and trip the kill-switch.

venue_error_rate_bps_to_halt.description: Rolling-window venue error rate (basis points) that trips `Halted`.

venue_min_window_samples.description: Minimum window samples before the error-rate gate is evaluated (avoids small-N trips).

venue_window_secs.description: Rolling observation window length in seconds.

ExecutionRiskPolicy.description: Capital, sizing, order, exit, reconciliation, and breaker policy.

ExitMonitorPolicy.description:
Exit-monitor cadence and re-inference policy.

Price/time/trailing tiers run every `monitor_secs`; model re-inference runs
at most every `signal_recheck_secs` per lot. Invalidation thresholds are
frozen in the intent's published trade-policy artifact.

enabled.description: Whether the exit-monitor worker actively evaluates open lots.

monitor_secs.description: Seconds between exit-monitor scans (price / time / trailing cadence).

signal_recheck_secs.description: Minimum seconds between signal re-inference checks for one lot.

ExitSignalReinferencePolicy.description:
Exit-monitor cadence and signal-degradation policy.

The monitor scans open position lots every `monitor_secs` for the price /
time / trailing / partial ladder; the heavier signal re-inference runs at
Model-backed thesis-invalidation re-inference policy.

When `enabled`, the exit monitor re-scores each lot's market via the
intent-frozen model and compares the fresh composite score against the entry
baseline. `shadow_mode` runs the full pipeline but suppresses
`ThesisInvalidated` exits (metrics + logs only) until operators disable it.

enabled.description: Whether model-backed signal re-inference is active.

shadow_mode.description:
When true, re-inference runs and is audited, but thesis-invalidation
exits are suppressed (fail-safe hold; SL/time/trailing still apply).

FeatureStalenessPolicy.description: Named policy for stale feature handling.

KillSwitchPolicy.description:
Execution kill-switch default policy.

Operational state lives in the `system_runtime_control` singleton. Runtime
config only carries the policy to apply when that state escalates.

MakerRebatePolicy.description: Frozen account-level policy for valuing delayed maker rebates.

fallback_lag_from_program_close_secs.description: Conservative lag from UTC program-day close while observed history is insufficient.

observed_p95_min_samples.description: Complete venue-reported-accrual to wallet-credit program days required for p95.

payout_threshold_usd.description: Day-local minimum venue-calculated accrual required for payout.

MarketCategory.description: Polymarket event category for business selection and model cohorts.

bound_at.description: Database decision time at which the binding became visible.

config_revision.description: Policy-bundle revision atomically committed with this binding.

model_version_id.description: Immutable model version selected for this exact Route and serving role.

source.description: Governance provenance that created the binding.

ModelBindingSource.description: Immutable provenance of one route-owned model binding.

oneOf.description: Feedback cycle that trained and bound the model.

ci_confidence.description: Two-sided confidence level for reliability-bin Wilson intervals.

embargo_secs.description:
Minimum embargo gap (seconds) between a model's training-dataset window
and its calibration-dataset window.

min_samples_isotonic.description: Minimum samples required to select isotonic (below ⇒ fit must use Platt).

ModelConfig.description: Route-owned Buy models and independent Sell model reference.

active_exit_model_version_id.description:
Champion Sell-side hold-vs-exit scorer version. The
opportunistic-Sell exit evaluator loads this; a distinct pointer from
Buy routes so Buy and Sell models are governed separately.

buy_routes.description:
Exact Buy-side bindings. A missing route fails closed and never falls
back to another route.

portfolio_scenario_model_bindings.description:
Exact scenario-model bindings. Lookup is by ordered Route-set digest;
absence or ambiguity fails the entire report.

ModelRouting.description: Active, shadow, and exit artifact routing.

report_published.description: Notify operators when a recommendation report is published.

OperationsPolicy.description: Immediate operational admission controls and notification routing.

OpportunisticSellPolicy.description:
Opportunistic-Sell operational control.

Advisory model-driven scale-out when the thesis still holds but the Sell
scorer ranks exiting now as better than holding. Evaluated at the same
cadence as re-inference (`signal_recheck_secs`) and gated behind
re-inference being enabled (thesis validity must be checkable first).

All trading thresholds and cumulative/clip bounds live exclusively in the
immutable policy and intent. Runtime may only disable or shadow an already
frozen rule; it cannot change that rule's decision boundary.

enabled.description: Whether opportunistic-Sell evaluation is active at all.

shadow_mode.description:
When true, the scorer runs and is audited but never submits an exit
(fail-safe hold; SL/time/trailing/invalidation still apply).

OutcomeReconciliationPolicy.description: Runtime cadence and bounded work budget for outcome reconciliation.

candidate_batch_size.description: Maximum recommendations or intents processed by each lane per pass.

economic_source_lateness_secs.description: Maximum arrival lag admitted before a horizon outcome seals typed censor evidence.

enabled.description: Whether the outcome reconciliation worker is enabled.

source_block_span.description: Maximum finalized source blocks scanned per resolution pass.

sweep_secs.description: Delay between reconciliation passes in seconds.

PolicyActivationOutcome.description: Outcome of an atomic policy activation transaction.

PolicyActivationView.description: Immutable activation record exposed by the Config API.

PolicyApprovalView.description: Immutable approval record exposed by the Config API.

max_orders_per_report.description: Maximum automatically authorized orders per report.

max_total_usd_per_report.description: Maximum total USD automatically authorized per report.

PolicyDocument.description:
Closed set of documents accepted by the governed policy repository.

`PostgreSQL` stores this aggregate in `JSONB` because revisions are immutable
documents and none of their leaf fields participate in database queries.
`SeaORM` still reads and writes the column as this Rust enum, never as an
untyped `serde_json::Value`.

PolicyPreflightDetailCode.description: Closed, localizable explanation vocabulary for Config preflight rows.

PolicyPreflightResult.description: One dependency or consumer preflight result.

failure_detail.description:
Optional machine-produced diagnostic for a failed dependency. Stable
success and skip explanations are represented by `detail_code`.

PolicyRevisionBundle.description: Revision identities frozen at a decision boundary.

PolicyValidationEvidence.description: Typed validation evidence persisted with a validated policy revision.

subject.description: Exact active bundle against which this revision was validated.

message_parameters.description: Stable interpolation inputs; UI copy is localized from `code`.

pointer.description: Canonical RFC 6901 pointer to the exact field or document boundary.

PolicyValidationSubject.description: Immutable subject bound to typed validation, preflight and approval.

PortfolioAdmission.description: Candidate admission floors applied before global optimization.

liquidity_buffer_bps.description: Additional executable-liquidity haircut applied to available depth, in basis points.

max_probability_interval_width_bps.description: Maximum calibrated probability-interval width admitted, in basis points.

min_nominal_expected_net_usd.description: Minimum nominal discounted expected net USD required for a tier to enter optimization.

min_profit_probability_bps.description: Conservative lower bound on the probability of positive net USD, in basis points.

min_robust_expected_net_usd.description: Minimum ambiguity-robust discounted expected net USD required before optimization.

cash_reserve_usd.description: Cash that must remain immediately available in every scenario.

max_open_capital_usd.description: Maximum capital that may be locked by all open positions and intents.

total_budget_usd.description: Maximum account capital that this strategy may govern.

PortfolioConfig.description:
Portfolio policy expressed entirely as hard economic constraints.

Policy limits only — never account state. Real equity and positions come
from the account snapshot, never from this configuration.

PortfolioExposureLimits.description: Exposure caps evaluated against existing positions plus selected tiers.

max_open_recommendations.description: Maximum number of simultaneously open recommendations.

max_route_exposure_usd.description: Maximum USD exposure per model Route.

max_single_recommendation_usd.description: Maximum USD allocated to one recommendation.

PortfolioScenarioModelArtifactBinding.description: Exact promoted scenario-generation model for one ordered represented Route set.

capital_time_bucket_contract_digest.description:
Digest of the strictly ordered capital-time boundaries. Per-bucket USD
caps remain in the frozen `ExecutionRiskPolicy` and do not require a
statistical scenario-model refit when only their values change.

PortfolioTailRisk.description: Scenario loss, `CVaR`, drawdown, and time-weighted capital limits.

capital_time_buckets.description: Strictly increasing capital-lock buckets; every tier must terminate in a covered bucket.

cvar_confidence_bps.description: `CVaR` confidence level in basis points, strictly between 0 and 10,000.

max_drawdown_usd.description: Maximum strategy drawdown admitted at the decision boundary.

max_scenario_loss_usd.description: Maximum allowed loss in any promoted or stress scenario.

RecommendationPolicy.description: Market-selection, data-quality, and recommendation payload semantics.

stale_open_secs.description:
Seconds an order may remain unreconciled (resting open, or unreadable at
the venue) before the worker forces a terminal resolution: a stale
resting order is actively cancelled, an unreadable order is escalated to
`Unresolvable`. Bounds how long capital can stay in-flight.

ReportSchedule.description: Durable report schedule resource, isolated from report decision semantics.

schedules.description: Complete governed schedule list; each entry owns cadence, `TopN`, lag, and enabled state.

cadence.description: How often this schedule fires (fixed interval or cron).

ad_hoc_default_knowledge_lag_secs.description: Default global knowledge lag frozen for an ad-hoc request without an override.

ad_hoc_default_top_n.description: Default `TopN` frozen when an ad-hoc request omits its override.

ad_hoc_report_enabled.description: Whether ad-hoc report generation is enabled.

entry_window_ratio.description:
Entry-window ratio in `(0, 1]`: a recommendation's entry-by deadline is
`as_of + effective_horizon * entry_window_ratio`. `0.5` enters only while
at least half the signal's edge remains (the half-life point); the
time-stop / exit still uses the full effective horizon.

hard_candidate_ceiling.description:
Deployment-proven upper bound for one complete catalog-visible report.
Exceeding it fails the report; it never truncates market candidates.

max_top_n.description:
Maximum `TopN` size (hard upper bound for every schedule and ad-hoc run,
capped by [`MAX_REPORT_TOP_N`]).

RuntimeFieldBounds.description: Exact numeric bounds represented without floating-point conversion.

RuntimeFieldControl.description: UI control selected from the exact Rust/JSON-Schema field shape.

RuntimeFieldDescriptor.description: Complete metadata for one editable or explicitly read-only Runtime leaf.

RuntimeFieldRiskLevel.description: Operator-risk classification for one field mutation.

RuntimeFieldUnit.description: Human unit rendered beside one Runtime Config control.

RuntimeVisibilityCondition.description: Typed condition controlling whether a dependent editor is visible.

oneOf.description: 6-field cron expression with an optional IANA timezone.

SchemaVersion.description:
A monotonic schema version for feature / factor / label / config schemas.

Wrapping the version prevents accidentally mixing it with unrelated integers
(counts, ids, ordinals) and makes "which schema generated this row" explicit
in every signature. Versions are `>= 1` by convention; untrusted wire and DB
values are validated through [`SchemaVersion::try_new`].

allow_near_resolution.description: Whether near-resolution markets may enter the selection.

enabled_categories.description: Category slugs eligible for quant reports.

max_spread_bps.description: Maximum allowed top-of-book spread in basis points.
